parameters.name: DbType
parameters.description:
The engine type. Valid values:

*   **redis**: Redis Open-Source Edition or Tair (In-Memory)
*   **tair_pena**: Tair (On NVM)
*   **tair_pdb**: Tair (On Disk)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameter-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-type redis --region cn-hangzhou
